name: Peak Design
summary: A gallery-grade monochrome commerce style with split dark/light editorial panels, studio product photography, Exposure-style display serif headlines, Geist body text, uppercase Bryant-style labels, flat product cards, hairline borders, and rare Ember Red emphasis.

typography.body: Geist, Inter, Sohne, Helvetica Neue, system-ui, sans-serif
typography.display: Exposure-style serif, Playfair Display, GT Super, Tiempos Headline, Georgia, serif
typography.label: Bryant-style condensed sans, Druk Wide, Inter Display Bold, Neue Haas Grotesk Display Bold, sans-serif
typography.mono: Geist Mono, JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Mono, monospace
rules: Use Exposure-style serif only for display headlines.
Use Geist for body, product text, forms, and footer.
Use Bryant-style condensed uppercase for nav, filters, buttons, and eyebrows.
Never set Bryant-style labels in mixed case.
